mechanism: Both agents cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte derangements (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia); amphotericin B may increase posaconazole levels through renal impairment, and combined use increases risk of acute kidney injury.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and urine output closely; consider nephroprotective measures; evaluate necessity of combination therapy and consider alternative antifungals when possible.
